YOUR GRAIN MARKETING PARTNER
In this digital age, speed is everything. Bigger equipment means a shorter harvest, so our facilities are geared to handle your grain quickly, get you back to the field, and keep that grain in top condition until it’s marketed.
Of course, markets move more quickly too. We’ll keep you connected with our daily commentary and the ability for you to make offers online on our Cash Bids page. Our Grain Marketing Program offers you the tools to help you formulate an effective marketing plan with the assistance of our experienced Grain Advisors
We have vital connections to local ethanol producers and soybean processors, and our 100-shuttle train loaders in Delavan, St. James, Randolph, and Welcome—located on two different railroads—link us to markets across the country and around the world.
If you’re looking for a partner who handles your grain exactly like you would, choose CFS.
Contact CFS Today >
Our Grain Locations >
CFS GRAIN MARKETING SERVICES
Partner with CFS Grain Marketing and you will make consistently better marketing decisions. You will have peace of mind knowing that our full-time marketing professionals, who have a vested interest in your success, are working every day to help you make better marketing decisions. This gives you more time and confidence to concentrate on production and growing your business.
CFS Grain Marketing >
STAY CONNECTED ON THE FARM, IN THE CAB, OR IN THE OFFICE.
Grain information at your fingertips! When it comes to farming and the grain markets timing matters, so having access to information that is quick and easy to use makes a difference. The CFS app provides solutions.
Access scale tickets, includes grades minutes after unloading at CFS location
View and sign grain contracts and sort by grain, location, and shipment periods
View cash grain bids and futures markets and submit offers to sell
Grain settlements and other transactions
Grain location hours
